riskAssessment.reason: The output must distinguish structural evidence changes from non-structural changes, preserve supplied facts, and reject same-period identity conflicts without touching shared Weekly Radar modules.
riskAssessment.reviewNotes: WR-001 owns the shared module skeleton; WR-006 uses an isolated source file and path-based integration test until a later WI deliberately composes the module.

reasons: Bounded Domain behavior with deterministic validation and no external side effects.

executionDecision.reason: The user supplied the exact implementation boundary and explicitly authorized execution, verification, and recording authorization in every Contract.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before implementation and before Finish to bind the active Contract/Summary evidence.

acceptance: ResearchState retains the same company identity and previous/current Stage values supplied by the caller; a company mismatch is rejected deterministically.
StructuralEvidenceDelta exposes Strengthened, Weakened, Invalidated, Unchanged, and non-structural Price/Rank/Score change kinds without deriving any kind from raw values.
Strengthened evidence produces one Rising event and Weakened or Invalidated evidence produces one Dropped event; Unchanged and Price/Rank/Score-only changes produce no event.
Each emitted event preserves the supplied period, event identity, company, previous/current Stage, reason, supporting evidence, counter evidence, missing proof, and next step in order.

WeeklyChangeSet preserves Rising and Dropped insertion order, rejects duplicate event identity, and rejects any same-period company identity appearing more than once, including a Rising/Dropped conflict.
The implementation does not recompute Stage, Ranking, Top5, Threshold Distance, or any score and has no dependency on WI-011 Reporting or external/runtime modules.

Focused unit and integration tests cover structural strengthening, non-Top5 Rising, stage/evidence weakening Dropped, correction/invalidated Dropped, price/rank/score-only no-event behavior, unchanged no-event behavior, order/fact retention, and same-period identity rejection.

The design spec, implementation plan, reference-impact evidence, Summary, Outcome, and AI Cockpit lifecycle records capture the authorization, current-WI issue policy, verification evidence, limitations, and next action.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Keep the standalone WR-006 Domain source independent of Weekly Radar shared modules and other feature implementations.
Treat previous/current states and StructuralEvidenceDelta as supplied upstream facts; do not infer or recalculate Stage, Ranking, Top5, Distance, or score.
Preserve evidence identity and insertion order; reject duplicate or overlapping evidence identities deterministically.
Reject same-period event identity and company conflicts deterministically; do not silently merge or overwrite.
Resolve problems discovered within this Work Item in the current Work Item and record the fix in Summary, checkpoints, and Outcome; do not open a new WI for an in-scope correction.
Do not introduce rendering, persistence, delivery, scheduler, retry, trading, price prediction, target price, portfolio allocation, or capital-action behavior.

intent.problem: Weekly Radar has a shared snapshot boundary but no isolated typed output that turns an upstream structural evidence delta into Rising or Dropped while retaining the supplied before/after state and proof context.
constraints: Only write the declared WR-006 source, test, design/plan, reference-impact, and this Work Item's governed evidence paths; never edit the shared Weekly Radar module files or other WI files.
Use explicit upstream StructuralEvidenceDelta kinds. Structural strengthening may produce Rising even when the company is not Top5; structural weakening or invalidation may produce Dropped.
Price, rank, and score-only changes are non-structural and must emit no event. Stage, Ranking, Top5, Threshold Distance, and score semantics remain upstream or downstream concerns.
The parent agent will handle push, PR, merge, and close. This isolated owner stops after local archive, quality evidence, and commit.
intent.rationale: An isolated, fact-preserving event boundary lets later Weekly Radar composition consume deterministic Rising/Dropped outputs without allowing output generation to reinterpret market movement, ranking movement, or raw evidence.
